s0.ru: Массив из {n} ячеек начинает с нулей, индексы с 1. Записи идут по порядку, форма индекс=значение: {listing}. Повторная запись того же значения не меняет ячейку. Каково итоговое значение ячейки {k}?
s0.en: An array of {n} cells starts at zeros, with indexes from 1. Writes arrive in order as index=value: {listing}. Writing the value that is already there does not change the cell. What is the final value of cell {k}?

s1.en: An array of {n} cells starts at zeros, with indexes from 1. Writes arrive in order as index=value: {listing}. Writing the value that is already there does not change the cell. How many writes actually changed a cell?
